description: This file defines a utility for preprocessing markdown messages in chat UI, including stripping metadata, context blocks, timestamps, and parsing inline images.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.InlineImage
classes.description: Represents an inline image embedded in markdown with a label and an optional image data.

classes.name: ChatMarkdownPreprocessor.Result
classes.description: Contains the processed markdown text and a list of inline images extracted.

methods.name: preprocess(markdown:)
methods.description: Main static method to preprocess markdown input string, removing envelope data, message ID hints, context blocks, timestamps, and extracting inline images.

methods.name: inlineImage(label:source:)
methods.description: Creates an InlineImage object if the source is a base64 data URI.

methods.name: fallbackImageLabel(_:)
methods.description: Returns a sanitized fallback label for images when the source is not valid.

methods.name: stripEnvelope(_)
methods.description: Removes envelope headers from messages if they match certain patterns.

methods.name: looksLikeEnvelopeHeader(_)
methods.description: Determines if a header string appears to be an envelope header based on patterns or known channels.

methods.name: stripMessageIdHints(_)
methods.description: Removes message ID hints from the message content.

methods.name: stripInboundContextBlocks(_)
methods.description: Removes inbound context blocks, including JSON fenced blocks, from message content.

methods.name: shouldStripTrailingUntrustedContext(lines:, index:)
methods.description: Decides whether to strip trailing untrusted context based on specific markers.

methods.name: stripPrefixedTimestamps(_)
methods.description: Removes prefixed timestamp lines from messages.

methods.name: normalize(_)
methods.description: Normalizes line endings and trims excess blank lines.
